section_summary.extract_value: This abstract details the translation and validation of the Gratitude Questionnaire (GQ-6) into Italian. A web-based survey with 204 adult participants (M age = 28.96; SD = 10.27) was conducted to assess its psychometric properties, including factor structure, reliability, and construct validity, showing a negative association with loneliness. No specific study numbers are mentioned, indicating a single study.
